assertions.title: Fleet serving path works offline and does not use cloud state

steps.action: Run daemon with deny-network-outbound sandbox profile and no cloud credentials
steps.observed: Daemon bound local AF_UNIX socket under profile (allow default, deny network-outbound, allow network-bind/inbound).

steps.action: Read Fleet RPC and well-known file
steps.observed: RPC returned schemaVersion 1 snapshot, runningCount 0, persistenceHealth ok; fleet-snapshot.json matched and was archived.

steps.expected: Actual Fleet UI renders from local daemon
steps.observed: Normal app connected to the offline daemon; AX/screenshot show Live Agent Fleet, 0 agents running, Updated just now, honest Unknown rows.
No Firebase, Firestore, CloudSync or cloud-storage imports in fleet serving code; only the separately documented loopback Hermes URLSession delivery channel is present.

evidence.networkDeniedRun: validation/M6-hardening/ui-final/VAL-CROSS-018/daemon2.log; no network/cloud errors or requests observed

assertions.issues: The app itself was not sandboxed for the final UI capture because macOS seatbelt denied its local socket connect; the daemon remained under the deny-network profile, and the normal app used only the local socket.

frictions.description: Native SwiftUI AX popup menu selection for Fleet designation returned -25202/element-outside-target-window.
frictions.resolution: Used the documented daemon-authoritative orchestrator.set RPC and verified the resulting Hermes state in FleetView.
Restarted the fresh journey with the base loopback URL http://127.0.0.1:18650 rather than a URL already containing the path.

frictions.description: First sandbox profile denied Unix socket bind as well as outbound network.
frictions.resolution: Used explicit local network-bind/inbound allowances with network-outbound denied; daemon RPC and UI then worked.

cleanup.details: Validator-owned BurnBar app, daemon, and fake gateway PIDs were stopped by exact PID/socket resolution. Evidence was copied to the allowed ui-final directory. Temporary /tmp namespaces were removed after evidence archival; no product, protected WIP, agent root, mission ledger, or ~/.factory/artifacts path was touched.

summary: All four assigned assertions passed. CROSS-011 passed with the documented code-inspection fallback for the real menu-bar popover; CROSS-016 passed with two live clients across three ticks; CROSS-017 passed end to end through approved Hermes delivery and fresh reader parity; CROSS-018 passed with a local daemon under outbound-denied sandbox and actual Fleet UI rendering.
